answer: Mint rewards only from outside demand. New POA is issued in proportion to fees that real clients pay for finished work, never for raw activity, and every fee carries a 10% burn. Picture a nebula of 500 fresh agents hiring each other for pigment-matching jobs: each payment is their own money looping back, so the farm shrinks like a dying ember, while one honest color-bot paid by actual print shops grows. Sybils can fake work, but not paying customers.
